 Bonus, stock splits & dividends: Dabur India, HUL, ONGC among 76 companies turning ex-record date this week
 SECTIONS Bonus, stock splits & dividends: Dabur India, HUL, ONGC among 76 companies turning ex-record date this week By Debaroti Adhikary , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Nov 08, 2026, 10:53:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis As many as 76 companies, including Dabur India, HUL, ONGC, NBCC, and HUDCO, have set record dates for dividends, stock splits, and bonus issues during the week of November 9-13. Markets remain closed on Tuesday, November 10, for Diwali-Balipratipada.
 ETMarkets.com As many as 76 companies including Dabur India , Hindustan Unilever ( HUL ), ONGC , NBCC , HUDCO and others have scheduled record dates for dividends, bonus issues and other corporate actions during the holiday-shortened week of November 9 (Monday) to November 13 (Friday).
 To be eligible for these corporate actions, investors must hold the shares in their demat accounts as of the respective record dates. The list is tentative, as more companies may announce record dates for dividends, bonus issues, stock splits and rights issues during the week.
Also read | Muhurat Trading 2026: How to trade during the special session today to welcome Samvat 2083? 
Here is the day-wise list of corporate actions to watch out for this week:
 November 9 (Monday) 
 Live Events
 The shares of Dabur India will turn ex-record date for an interim dividend of Rs 3.5 per share, while Esab India will pay Rs 20 per share. Other companies which have fixed Monday as the record date for their respective dividends include Brisk Technovision (Rs 2 per share), Ganesh Consumer Products (Rs 3.7 per share), Labelkraft Technologies (Rs 1 per share), Metropolis Healthcare (Rs 1 per share), Oswal Agro Mills (Rs 0.5 per share), Saksoft (Rs 0.5 per share) and Interise Trust.
 November 10 (Tuesday) 
 No major corporate actions are scheduled for Tuesday when the stock market will be closed on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
Also read | Stock Market Holiday 2026: When will BSE & NSE be closed for Diwali? Muhurat trading timings, other key things to know 
 November 11 (Wednesday) 
Wednesday marks the record date for dividend rewards by several notable companies, including Container Corporation of India or CONCOR (Rs 1.9 per share), HUDCO (Rs 1.35 per share), NBCC (Rs 0.25 per share) and Aurobindo Pharma (Rs 7 per share).
 Balkrishna Industries and Balrampur Chini Mills will each pay an interim dividend of Rs 4 per share, while Chambal Fertilisers and Chemicals and Dr Lal Pathlabs will pay dividends worth Rs 5 per share each.
Other dividend stocks with record dates fixed on Wednesday include JM Financial (Rs 1.65 per share), Navneet Education (special dividend of Rs 1.5 per share and interim dividend of Rs 1.5 per share), NRB Bearings (Rs 2.5 per share), PDS (Rs 2.2 per share), Premier Energies (Rs 0.5 per share), Rites (Rs 1.9 per share), SNL Bearings (Rs 6 per share), and Sonata Software (Rs 1.25 per share). Additionally, Zodiac-JRD-MKJ has fixed Wednesday as the record date for its rights issue of 145 shares for every 100 shares held at an issue price of Rs 25.
 November 12 (Thursday) 
Thursday will see heavy corporate action activity, led by FMCG major Hindustan Unilever (HUL) paying an interim dividend of Rs 19 per share and state-run Oil & Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC) turning ex-dividend. Other key companies going ex-dividend on Thursday include Bayer CropScience (Rs 90 per share), Godfrey Phillips India (Rs 10 per share), Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys (Rs 5 per share), Insecticides (India) (Rs 5 per share), Safari Industries (India) (Rs 2 per share), Gujarat Pipavav Port (Rs 3 per share), NLC India (Rs 1.5 per share), GPT Healthcare (Rs 1 per share), Gaja Alternative Asset Management (Rs 0.5 per share), IRB Infrastructure Developers (Rs 0.05 per share), and Taparia Tools (Rs 40 per share).
Also read | Muhurat Trading 2026: Sensex, Nifty has 80% strike rate. Will this trend continue as Samvat 2083 kicks off? 
 November 13 (Friday) 
Rounding off the week on Friday, several notable names will go ex-dividend, including Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) (Rs 3.25 per share), Emami (Rs 5 per share), The Great Eastern Shipping Company (Rs 14.4 per share), Transworld Shipping Lines (Rs 11 per share), Premco Global (Rs 10 per share), Somany Ceramics (Rs 6 per share), Pearl Global Industries (Rs 5 per share), Repco Home Finance (Rs 5 per share), TAAL Tech (Rs 5 per share), Shivalik Bimetal Controls (Rs 2 per share), Dynamatic Technologies (Rs 2 per share), Orient Technologies (Rs 2 per share), Aptus Value Housing Finance India (Rs 2 per share), Astral (Rs 1.5 per share), BMW Ventures (Rs 1.5 per share), PPAP Automotive (Rs 1.5 per share), Star Cement (Rs 1 per share), Mafatlal Industries (Rs 1 per share), SP Capital Financing (Rs 0.75 per share), Techknowgreen Solutions (Rs 0.5 per share), Rain Industries (Rs 0.5 per share), Ramdevbaba Solvent (Rs 0.5 per share), Precision Wires India (Rs 0.35 per share), Mobavenue Ai Tech (Rs 0.1 per share), iStreet Network (Rs 0.05 per share), Bhatia Communications & Retail (India) (Rs 0.01 per share), and IG Petrochemicals.
Apart from dividends, Friday will also feature other major corporate actions. BN Agrochem will undergo a 1:10 stock split. Dharti Proteins has scheduled its record date for a 1:1 bonus issue, while Kanel Industries will go ex-record date for a rights issue.
